card.name: Small words in chronic myeloid leukemia labels
card.fires_on: Small linking words (for, in, with, on) and spaces right after CML or leukemia-phase wording in kinase inhibitor labels. Also the ML inside the abbreviation CML-CP.

modes.label: Link word after CML
modes.description: A short word such as for, in, with or on that follows CML or a CML phase and introduces a population or treatment group.
modes.example: The recommended starting dosage of Dasatinib tablets<< for>> accelerated phase CML,

modes.label: Inside CML abbreviations
modes.description: The ML part of CML-CP or CML-AP in an abbreviation list.
modes.example: 30 mg/m 2 twice daily. Abbreviations: CML-AP, chronic myeloid leukemia-accelerated phase; C<<ML>>-CP, chronic myeloid leukemia

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A space token before a number in dose or blood count thresholds in CML dosing text.
